facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-3220 during transfer operations

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3220 and PT-3220 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 26 October 2008 an incident occurred on P-3220 and PT-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
